payload.artist_html: Peter Houde; Meig Dickson; Dakota Camarena
payload.credit_html: Houde et al. 2023. Basal Anseriformes from the Early Paleogene of North America and Europe . Diversity 15(2). https://doi.org/10.3390/d15020233
payload.description_html:
Tarsometarsi of holotype Danielsacis nazansis, an extinct basal Anseriforme.

Figure caption from source: "Caudal aspect of tarsometatarsi of London Clay screamer-like Anseriformes familia incertae sedis: holotype of Danielsavis nazensis nov. gen. et sp. (NMS.Z.2021.40.1) left (A), left (NMS.Z.2021.40.6) (B), proximal and distal extremities of right (NMS.Z.2021.40.3) (C), distal left (NMS.Z.2021.40.5) (D), left (NMS.Z.2021.40.4) (E). Scale bar 1 cm."

Photo is a figure from: Houde, P., Dickson, M., & Camarena, D. (2023). Basal Anseriformes from the Early Paleogene of North America and Europe. Diversity, 15(2), 233. https://doi.org/10.3390/d15020233
